description: Defines the HttpStreamParser class for handling HTTP stream parsing, including request sending, response reading, and connection management within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpStreamParser
classes.description: Handles parsing of HTTP streams, including sending requests, reading responses, managing connection reuse, and encoding chunks.

methods.name: HttpStreamParser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with socket, request info, buffer, and logging.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified headers and traffic annotation, and processes the response.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads response body asynchronously into provided buffer.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully received.

methods.name: CanFindEndOfResponse
methods.description: Determines if the end of the response can be identified.

methods.name: IsMoreDataBuffered
methods.description: Checks if more response data is buffered.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Indicates if the current connection can be reused based on response and connection state.

methods.name: OnConnectionClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the connection is closed.

methods.name: EncodeChunk
methods.description: Encodes payload into chunked transfer format.

methods.name: ShouldMergeRequestHeadersAndBody
methods.description: Determines if request headers and body should be merged.
